sloka: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ मम त्वं हि कृत्वा विप्रियमीद्दशम् ।क्व नु राक्षसशार्दूल गतो मोक्षमवाप्स्यसि ।। ६.५९.१३१ ।।।।
transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mama tvaṁ hi kṛtvā vipriyamīddaśam ।kva nu rākṣasaśārdūla gato mokṣamavāpsyasi ।। 6.59.131 ।।।।

translations.english: "If you go to Indra or Yama or Sun God or the selfborn Brahma or fire God or Shankara or the ten directions like that, and if you run in front of me you cannot escape."
